name: GMV
aliases: 成交总额,销售额,营业额,卖了多少钱,营收
definition: 支付成功且未取消订单的商品金额合计，不含运费，按支付时间归属
formula: SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) FROM safe.orders o JOIN safe.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= :start AND o.paid_at < :end

name: 订单数
aliases: 成交单量,订单量,多少单,卖掉多少单
definition: 支付成功且未取消的订单数量，按支付时间归属，一个订单算一单
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM safe.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= :start AND o.paid_at < :end

name: 客单价
aliases: 平均订单金额,每单金额,AOV
definition: GMV 除以订单数，反映每笔订单的平均成交金额
formula: GMV / 订单数，时间范围与口径同 GMV

name: 退款金额
aliases: 退货金额,退款总额,退了多少钱
definition: 退款完成状态下的退款金额合计，按退款完成时间归属
formula: SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM safe.refunds r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= :start AND r.completed_at < :end

name: 退货率
aliases: 退款率,退货比例,退了多少
definition: 统计期内退款金额合计除以同期 GMV，按退款完成时间归属退款，按支付时间归属 GMV

name: 广告花费
aliases: 投放费用,广告费,推广花费,推广费用
definition: 广告日报中的花费合计，按统计日期归属
formula: SUM(ads.spend) FROM safe.ad_daily_stats ads WHERE ads.stat_date >= :start_date AND ads.stat_date < :end_date

name: ROI
aliases: 投入产出比,投放回报,投产比
definition: 广告归因成交金额除以广告花费，按统计日期归属
formula: SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(ads.spend), 0) FROM safe.ad_daily_stats ads WHERE ads.stat_date >= :start_date AND ads.stat_date < :end_date

name: 发货时效
aliases: 物流时效,发货速度,几天到,签收时长
definition: 从订单支付到物流签收的平均小时数，只统计已签收的包裹
formula: AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)) FROM safe.orders o JOIN safe.shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.paid_at >= :start AND o.paid_at < :end

name: 商品销量
definition: 订单明细中购买件数的合计，只统计支付成功且未取消的订单
formula: SUM(oi.quantity) FROM safe.orders o JOIN safe.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= :start AND o.paid_at < :end
